cuts.ofreeRecent: standing; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — standing; the grand staircase of an old castle — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; her living room with a deep sofa — sitting on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — dries her hair with a towel; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a rocky coast path with tide pools — holds a paper kite on a string's string up; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table
